text: Now consider a different graph with sizes two, two, one, and one. The strongest edge joins C and D, so greedy merges them first. All three remaining clusters have size two, and capacity three blocks every further merge. Yet pairing node A with C, and node B with D, gives two legal clusters of size three. Here the target is feasible; the greedy history, not total available capacity, causes the failure.

cues.en: Now consider a different graph with sizes two, two, one, and one.
cues.zh: 现在看另一个图，四个节点大小分别为二、二、一、一。

cues.en: The strongest edge joins C and D, so greedy merges them first.
cues.zh: 最强的边连接 C 与 D，因此贪心算法先合并它们。

cues.en: All three remaining clusters have size two, and capacity three blocks every further merge.
cues.zh: 剩下的三个簇大小都为二，容量三使后续任何合并都不合法。

cues.en: Yet pairing node A with C, and node B with D, gives two legal clusters of size three.
cues.zh: 但 A 与 C、B 与 D 分别成簇，就能得到两个大小为三的合法簇。

cues.en: Here the target is feasible; the greedy history, not total available capacity, causes the failure.
cues.zh: 这里目标是可行的；失败源于贪心选择的历史，而不是总容量不足。
